name: What is the step-by-step process for repairing damaged drywall in a basement?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for repairing damaged drywall in a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A basement drywall repair project begins with an on-site assessment to inspect the damage, measure the area, and check behind the wall for dampness or structural framing issues. The work area is prepped with floor protection and dust barriers. The crew cleanly cuts back damaged gypsum to the nearest studs, hangs fresh drywall panels, and embeds fiberglass or paper tape with joint compound. Successive mud coats are feathered and sanded smooth. Finally, the contractor replicates the surrounding texture—such as knockdown or orange peel—before applying primer and matching interior paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves cutting out damaged sections to the studs, hanging new drywall, taping and applying joint compound, sanding smooth, matching texture, and painting.
